description: Telemetry sink admin (D22): READ-ONLY reconciliation listing of minted-token records (runId, role, kind, tokenId digest, createdAt, revokedAt) from the sink's tokens.json. No plaintext exists in that file; nothing is written. Diff against the founder's mint log after each run.

runId.description: Optional run id filter (empty = all records)

runCommand: if [ -n "$R" ]; then exec docker exec "$CID" node dist/list-tokens-cli.js --runId "$R"; else exec docker exec "$CID" node dist/list-tokens-cli.js; fi
